caution_findings.evidence_context: DBAASP-linked rows using Klebsiella pneumoniae ATCC 43816 and Enterococcus faecium NTCC 12697 conflict with primary source ATCC CRM 43861 and NCTC 12697. Values are retained but those rows remain source_conflict.

DBAASP percent-cytotoxicity classes at 100 μM are not exact numeric table values in local XML/PDF; Figure 8 is graphical and Table 6 gives IC50/N.I. endpoints. These rows remain source_conflict, not fabricated source_verified values.
The local supplementary ZIP contains a PDF with RP-HPLC purity and MALDI-TOF spectra figures for the five peptides; it does not add extractable activity/toxicity tables.

materials_exhausted.note: Bounded local review exhausted the XML/NXML, extracted PDF text, OA package, supplementary ZIP PDF text, locator index, and linked DBAASP JSONL rows relevant to worker-4/6 blockers.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: Worker-4 reconciled 215 linked DBAASP assay/experiment/literature rows. Source-verified rows match Tables 1-6/article metadata; 42 rows remain source_conflict for strain typo/conflict or figure-only percent cytotoxicity classes and are preserved as cautions.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Worker-6 final activity/toxicity file records all source-supported Table 3 Ki, Table 4 MIC/MBC, Table 5 HC20, and Table 6 IC50/N.I. values with raw units and locators. Figure-only percent cytotoxicity values were not fabricated.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Mechanism claims are bounded to direct assays actually present locally: trypsin inhibition, SYTOX membrane permeability, time-kill/in vivo antibacterial phenotypes, and Annexin V/PI apoptosis. No unsupported molecular target is inferred.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_4_review: The prior framework-only review ticket is closed by this source-reviewed worker-4/6 pass; remaining issues are nonblocking cautions, not open rework targets.

summary: Source-reviewed worker-4/6 re-review completed for the Pharmaceutics 2024 Kunitz-derived OSTI peptide paper. Primary Tables 1-6 and the supplementary ZIP were reopened; database rows are now verified where exact source support exists and conflicts remain explicit where DBAASP strain labels or figure-only percent classes are not exact source-table values.
title: An Effective Modification Strategy to Build Multifunctional Peptides Based on a Trypsin Inhibitory Peptide of the Kunitz Family.
